scheme_name: Maulana Azad National Fellowship For Minority Students
other_conditions: Applicant must belong to a minority community (Buddhist, Christian, Jain, Muslim, Sikh, or Zoroastrian (Parsi)).
Applicant must qualify the UGC-NET or Joint CSIR-UGC NET examination.
Applicants who have completed their research work during the fellowship period are not eligible to apply again.
Applicants who have previously availed any fellowship, fully or partially, are not eligible.
Employees of any university, college, educational institution, or central, state, or union territory government are not eligible, even on study or EOL leave.
benefits_summary: Monthly stipend of ₹31,000 for JRF and ₹35,000 for SRF, with additional contingency and assistance for physically and visually disabled candidates.
